author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override kd22 k50 δ0.118 emb_k=17 γ_max=0.70 (DAQB)
abstract: Same fixed-λ (0.605) runner at kd=22,k=50 with δ=0.118 (micro near 0.12) and γ_max=0.70; aims to capture δ sensitivity and clear ≥0.744 with PCR≈1.0.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.118,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
